items.title: SmartTube
items.subtitle: The Android TV client whose behaviour ProsperoTube follows. MIT. None of its code or assets is included.

items.subtitle: The desktop client whose way of reading YouTube without an account the built-in service follows. AGPL-3.0-or-later. No code included.

items.subtitle: The player ProsperoTube is built on, by sainsaji; derived from ProsperoPlayer by KINGDKAK. GPL-3.0-or-later.

items.title: YouTube.js (youtubei.js) 18.1.0
items.subtitle: YouTube access of the built-in service. MIT.

items.title: QuickJS-NG 0.17.0
items.subtitle: JavaScript engine of the built-in service. MIT.

items.title: FFmpeg 7.1.1
items.subtitle: Demuxing and software decoding. LGPL-2.1-or-later, with GPL parts as configured.

items.title: dav1d 1.5.1
items.subtitle: AV1 software decoding. BSD-2-Clause.

items.title: curl 8.18.0, libpsl 0.21.5 and Mozilla's root certificates
items.subtitle: HTTPS of the built-in service and its trusted roots. curl license, MIT and MPL-2.0.

items.title: OpenSSL 3.5.2
items.subtitle: TLS. Apache-2.0.

items.title: SponsorBlock and DeArrow
items.subtitle: Community segment data, titles and thumbnails by Ajay Ramachandran and contributors. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

items.title: RmlUi 6.2, SDL2 and zlib
items.subtitle: The classic interface, the platform layer and compression. MIT and zlib license.

items.title: ps5-homebrew-ui
items.subtitle: The interface kit Afterglow and the player's controls are drawn with, by the same author. GPL-3.0-or-later.

items.title: HarfBuzz 9.0.0, FreeType 2.13.2 and GNU FriBidi 1.0.15
items.subtitle: Text shaping, glyphs and text direction. Old MIT, FreeType Project License and LGPL-2.1-or-later.

items.title: Inter, Montserrat and DejaVu Sans Mono
items.subtitle: The typefaces. SIL Open Font License 1.1; Bitstream Vera and DejaVu licences.

items.title: Interface sounds
items.subtitle: Original procedural synthesis by BlackBearReloaded. GPL-3.0-or-later.

items.title: cJSON 1.7.19 and PS5-Lapy-JB-Daemon
items.subtitle: JSON reading and writing; the packaged one-shot storage helper. MIT.

items.title: PS5 Payload SDK 0.42, Pacbrew 0.39 and MkPFS
items.subtitle: Toolchain, runtime libraries and package image. The SDK is GPL-3.0-or-later; the others keep their upstream licenses.

items.title: ProsperoTV, ProsperoLight and ps5-native-app-boilerplate

items.title: Unicode Character Database 15.0.0
